items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And that's how I met Buster Smith and I started playing with him. We played dances with some of the little groups, even with Buster's little band.

ctx.x: Well, how did you come to get with the Blue Devils?
Probably through Buster Smith and Booker Pittman. I knew them when they had the band they called the Blue Moon Chasers.
Well, he was quite a ladies' man, too, wasn't he?

items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Durham told me that he went down there... Last time, Eddie Durham told me...

ctx.x: He wasn't happy with Sugar Lou and Eddie?

I don't remember. I mean, we had a better band. I guess a better band, and we was working more. I think Sugar Lou and Eddie, they only worked on weekends or something... Well, not only. But we used to play from town to town and every night.
So you were a pretty popular band.
